reason: On a night or early shift I need something that actually keeps me up, and 80 mg is less than the Monster I usually grab. Paying 55 CZK for less kick than my normal can doesn't make sense to me.
objection: 80 mg of caffeine is less than my usual can, so I doubt I'd even feel it at 4 a.m., and at 55 CZK it costs more than the drink that works.
would_change_my_mind: A free can or a tasting at the café I eat at, so I could see whether it gets me through a shift without the crash. If it did, I'd swap it in for the afternoon can.
